// Quickstart: Trigger Saastify Agent Squad
import { SaastifyClient } from '@saastify/sdk';

const client = new SaastifyClient({
  apiKey: process.env.SAASTIFY_API_KEY
});

const job = await client.agents.execute({
  squad: 'engineering',
  goal: 'Provision cluster & audit code'
});

console.log('Status:', job.status);
